properties.source: Florida Current and Gulf Stream to the Tail of the Grand Banks: streamline traced by script through the NOAA AOML Global Drifter Program annual-mean near-surface velocity climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017; public domain), smoothed to about 1 deg and simplified (separation from the shelf at Cape Hatteras, 35.4 N).
refs: NOAA AOML GDP drifter annual-mean climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017, doi:10.1016/j.dsr.2017.04.009; dataset doi:10.7266/N7SJ1HN5; accessed 2026-10-12)

properties.source: North Atlantic Current and Drift: hand-traced simplified axis, checked against streamlines of the NOAA AOML Global Drifter Program annual-mean near-surface velocity climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017; public domain), which show it north along the Grand Banks to the Northwest Corner near 51 N 43 W, east near 50-52 N across the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, then north-east past Rockall and through the Faroe-Shetland Channel into the Norwegian Sea. The mean flow here is broad and eddy-rich, so this line is schematic.
refs: NOAA AOML GDP drifter annual-mean climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017, doi:10.1016/j.dsr.2017.04.009; dataset doi:10.7266/N7SJ1HN5; accessed 2026-10-12)
